changeSet.author: ged
changeSet.comment: Issue de l'indexation du dépôt sur document (INDEXE, SANS_PLAN, A_INDEXER).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document ADD CONSTRAINT ck_document_statut_indexation CHECK (statut_indexation IN ('INDEXE', 'SANS_PLAN', 'A_INDEXER'))

UPDATE ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document d SET statut_indexation = CASE WHEN t.plan_indexation_id IS NULL THEN 'SANS_PLAN' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document_index_valeur v WHERE v.document_id = d.id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.plan_index pi JOIN ${database.defaultSchemaName}.index_def i ON i.id = pi.index_def_id WHERE pi.plan_indexation_id = t.plan_indexation_id AND i.obligatoire AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.document_index_valeur v WHERE v.document_id = d.id AND v.index_def_id = i.id AND btrim(coalesce(v.valeur, '')) <> '')) THEN 'INDEXE' ELSE 'A_INDEXER' END FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.type_document t WHERE t.id = d.type_document_id
